capture_frames_dimensions_check.name: capture_frames_dimensions_check
capture_frames_dimensions_check.value: ("capture_frames"."width" IS NULL AND "capture_frames"."height" IS NULL) OR ("capture_frames"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "capture_frames"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "capture_frames"."width" > 0 AND "capture_frames"."height" > 0)

scan_revisions_approval_state_check.name: scan_revisions_approval_state_check
scan_revisions_approval_state_check.value: ("scan_revisions"."status" IN ('approved', 'superseded') AND "scan_revisions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("scan_revisions"."status" IN ('draft', 'rejected') AND "scan_revisions"."approved_by" IS NULL)
